perks.name: Scoot to Loot
perks.description: Sliding collects nearby ammo and temporarily grants enhanced reload speed and handling to your weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 滑行会收集附近的弹药，并在短时间内为你的武器提供强化的填装速度和操控性。

perks.name: Shoot to Scoot
perks.description: Dealing damage with your weapons temporarily grants enhanced sliding. Sliding provides damage resistance.
perks.descriptionZh: 用武器造成伤害会在短时间内提供强化滑行。滑行时会获得伤害抗性。

perks.name: Rasputin's Wrath
perks.description: Final blows with area-of-effect damage, Solar abilities, Seventh Seraph weapons, or IKELOS weapons grant Warmind Charges. Each stack of Warmind Charge increases your Weapons and Grenade stats.
perks.descriptionZh: 范围效果伤害、烈日技能、第七炽天使武器或似像者武器最后一击提供战争思维充能。每层战争思维充能都会提升你的武器和手雷属性。

perks.name: Rasputin's Reprisal
perks.description:
While you have Warmind Charges, defeating powerful combatants, destroying a construct, or destroying a Tangle releases a Solar detonation that damages combatants and heals allies.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
perks.descriptionZh:
持有战争思维充能时，击败强力战斗人员、摧毁构造体，或摧毁缠结会释放一次烈日爆炸，对战斗人员造成伤害并治疗盟友。

构造体包括屏障、炮台、冰影水晶以及其他在战场上生成的物体。

perks.name: Wrecker
perks.description: You deal significantly increased Kinetic damage to combatant shields, overshields, vehicles, and constructs. Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
perks.descriptionZh: 你对战斗人员护盾、覆盖护盾、载具和构造体造成的动能伤害显著提升。构造体包括屏障、炮台、冰影水晶以及其他在战场上生成的物体。

perks.name: Concussive Rounds
perks.description: Defeating powerful combatants or breaking a combatant shield with Kinetic damage releases a disorienting Kinetic shockwave.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用动能伤害击败强力战斗人员或破坏战斗人员护盾会释放具有迷失效果的动能冲击波。

perks.name: Iron Sharpens Iron
perks.description: Final blows on Guardians and powerful combatants generate additional ammo progress.
perks.descriptionZh: 对守护者和强力战斗人员造成最后一击时生成额外的弹药进度。

perks.name: Ascendant Escape
perks.description: After a final blow on a powerful combatant, the next time your shields are broken, you become invisible.
perks.descriptionZh: 对强力战斗人员造成最后一击后，下一次你的护盾被击破时，你获得隐形。

perks.name: Vigilant Watch
perks.description: As your health gets lower, your weapons gain increased stability and handling. Weapon final blows while your shields are depleted heal you.
perks.descriptionZh: 随着你的生命值降低，你的武器获得稳定性和操控性提升。护盾耗尽时造成武器最后一击可获得治疗。

perks.name: Iron Conviction
perks.description: When your shields become broken, you gain increased ammo generation, flinch resistance, and damage resistance against nearby combatants for a short time. Final blows extend this effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你的护盾破裂时，你在短时间内获得弹药生成速度、抖动抗性和对附近战斗人员伤害抗性提升。最后一击会延长此效果。

perks.name: Resonant Plating
perks.description: Your health begins regenerating immediately after taking melee damage from a powerful combatant.
perks.descriptionZh: 受到强力战斗人员的近战伤害后立即开始回复生命值。

perks.name: Siphoning Touch
perks.description: Gain stacks of Siphoning Touch for weapon or Glaive melee hits. Switching weapons heals you and consumes all stacks.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用武器或偃月造成近战命中获得虹吸之触层数。切换武器会消耗所有层数来治疗你自己。

perks.name: A Wish for Protection
perks.description: Taking significant damage in a short time generates a Protective Wish that makes it harder for combatants to hit you, and grants increased reload speed and flinch resistance.
perks.descriptionZh: 短时间内受到大量伤害会生成一层庇护之愿，让战斗人员更难命中你，并提供填装速度和抖动抗性加成。

perks.name: A Wish Fulfilled
perks.description:
When the Protective Wish expires, it cures you. 

Rapid final blows prematurely end the Protective Wish.
perks.descriptionZh:
庇护之愿失效时获得治愈。

快速最后一击会提前结束庇护之愿。

perks.name: Ionic Overclock
perks.description: While amplified, your Fusion Rifles, Linear Fusion Rifles, and Heat weapons gain increased handling, reload, and vent speeds.
perks.descriptionZh: 当处于增幅状态时，你的融合步枪、线性融合步枪以及热量武器可获得更高的操控性、填装和排气速度。

perks.name: Shock and Clear
perks.description: Final blows with Jolt or against jolted combatants create Ionic Traces.
perks.descriptionZh: 以震颤造成最后一击，或对被震颤的战斗人员造成最后一击时，会生成离子轨迹。

perks.name: Network Admin
perks.description:
Being near allies creates a relay network that gives the wearer improved handling and reload speed. 

Being near other allied Network Admins additionally grants the wearer a bonus to Health stat.
perks.descriptionZh:
靠近盟友会生成一个中继网络，提升装备者的操控性和填装速度。

靠近其他友方网络管理员额外提升装备者的生命值属性。

perks.name: Network Upload
perks.description: Weapon final blows grant the wearer and nearby allies melee energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 武器最后一击为装备者和附近盟友提供近战能量。

perks.name: Taken Barrier
perks.description: Grenade final blows temporarily reduce incoming damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 手雷最后一击会在短时间内减少你受到的伤害。

perks.name: Taken Armaments
perks.description: Grenade final blows grant additional Heavy ammo progress.
perks.descriptionZh: 手雷最后一击会提供额外的重型弹药进度。

perks.name: Radiolaria Breach
perks.description: After picking up an Orb of Power, the next time your shields are broken, gain a bonus to Health stat for a short duration and release a burst of radiolaria around you.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球后，下一次你的护盾被击破时，在短时间内获得生命值属性加成并向周围释放一股活性放射体液。

perks.name: Collective Power
perks.description: While you have a subclass buff, dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有分支职业增益时，造成持续伤害会生成一个能量球。

perks.name: Primary Survivor
perks.description: When an ally is defeated, Primary ammo weapons gain increased handling, reload speed, target acquisition, and reduced flinch. Bonus increases when multiple allies are dead at the same time or when you are running solo.
perks.descriptionZh: 当一名盟友被击败时，提高主弹药武器的操控性、填装速度、目标捕获能力并减轻抖动。当多名盟友同时死亡或单人行动时，加成提升。

perks.name: Primary Phantom
perks.description: Final blows with Primary ammo weapons remove you from radar for a short time. Drawing a weapon that does not use Primary ammo will immediately end this effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用主弹药武器造成最后一击将使你暂时从雷达中消失。举起非主弹药武器将立即中断此效果。

perks.name: Augmented Servos
perks.description: Powered melees release an additional disorienting pulse when used to defeat a target.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用充能近战击败目标时额外释放一道迷失脉冲。

perks.name: God-like Judgment
perks.description: When your shields are broken by a combatant, or upon casting your Super, release a swarm of heat seeking micro-missiles.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的护盾被战斗人员击破，或你使用超能时，发射大量追踪热源的微型导弹。

perks.name: Force Absorption
perks.description: Final blows with a Rocket Launcher, Grenade Launcher, or micro-missile temporarily decrease incoming area-of-effect damage.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用火箭发射器、榴弹发射器或微型导弹造成最后一击后，暂时减少受到的范围效果伤害。

perks.name: Reactive Shock
perks.description: When Force Absorption is active, taking melee damage causes you to emit a disorienting burst once.
perks.descriptionZh: 力量吸收生效时，受到近战伤害将触发一次迷失爆发。

perks.name: Accretion
perks.description: Picking up an ammo brick gives you a stacking bonus to weapon swap and stow speeds until you die.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取弹药盒会提供可叠加的武器切换和收起速度加成，直到你死亡。

perks.name: Doppler Effect
perks.description: Suspend, unravel, and sever effects applied to targets, and radiant and restoration effects applied to you have increased duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 对目标施加的悬停、瓦解和割裂效果，以及对自身施加的焕光和恢复效果拥有更长的持续时间。

perks.name: Iaido
perks.description: Final blows with freshly drawn or reloaded weapons heal you.
perks.descriptionZh: 用刚刚拔出或填装的武器造成最后一击会治疗你。

perks.name: Unfaltering Focus
perks.description: Bow, Shotgun, or Sword final blows temporarily reduce incoming damage. Damaging targets with those weapons extends the effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 弓箭、霰弹枪或刀剑最后一击会暂时减少受到的伤害。使用这些武器对目标造成伤害可延长效果。

perks.name: Force Converter
perks.description: After a final blow with a Rocket Launcher, Grenade Launcher, or micro-missile, sprint for a short time to gain Speed Booster.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用火箭发射器、榴弹发射器或微型导弹造成最后一击后，冲刺一小段时间来获得速度加成。

perks.name: Reactive Booster
perks.description: Once per activation of Force Converter, sprinting while at critical health, being suspended, or being slowed by a Stasis effect will immediately grant Speed Booster for a short duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 每次激活力量转化器可生效一次，生命危急、被悬停或受冰影效果减速时冲刺，会立即获得短暂的速度加成。

perks.name: Queensfoil Rush
perks.description: Gain a powerful overshield while performing your finisher. When you finish a target, release a slowing burst around you.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用终结技时获得一个强大的覆盖护盾。终结目标时，在你周围释放一次减速爆发。

perks.name: Truth to Power
perks.description: Gain increasing damage resistance when you deal damage or land final blows. Finishers grant accelerated progress. At max stacks, the recharge rate of your abilities is also increased.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成伤害或最后一击时获得递增的伤害抗性。终结技提供更快的进度。层数叠满时，你的技能充能速度也将获得提升。

perks.name: Regenerative Threshold
perks.description: Performing a finisher stores power. The next time your shields are broken, consume stored power to immediately heal and start health regeneration.
perks.descriptionZh: 施展终结技会存储能量。下一次你的护盾被击破时，消耗储备的能量立即获得治疗并开启生命值回复。

perks.name: Melee Conduction
perks.description: While you have Radiant, Restoration, or Cure, your melee hits release a burst that will scorch the target.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有焕光、恢复或治愈时，你的近战命中会释放灼烧目标的冲击波。

perks.name: Between Poles
perks.description: Final blows with Light weapons grants stacks of Light Polarity, which grants Grenade stat. Final blows with Darkness or Kinetic weapons grants stacks of Dark Polarity, which grants stacks of Melee stat.
perks.descriptionZh: 光能武器最后一击提供赋予手雷属性的光能极性层数。暗影或动能武器最后一击提供赋予近战属性的暗影极性层数。

perks.name: So Very Thin
perks.description: Final blows with Light weapons grants additional grenade energy. Final blows with Dark or Kinetic weapons grants additional melee energy. Rapid final blows that alternate between Light and Darkness grant a short period of damage resistance.
perks.descriptionZh: 光能武器最后一击提供额外手雷能量。暗影或动能武器最后一击提供额外近战能量。光能与暗影交替的快速最后一击在短时间内提供伤害抗性。

perks.name: Untold Greed
perks.description: Picking up ammo, Orbs of Power, Elemental pickups, or destroying a Strand Tangle grants stacks of Untold Greed, slightly reducing damage taken and providing reload speed to equipped weapons. When your shields are broken, some stacks are lost.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取弹药、能量球、元素拾取物，或摧毁缚丝缠结时获得无尽贪婪层数，略微降低所受伤害，并为已装备武器提供填装速度加成。当你的护盾被击破时，会失去部分层数。

perks.name: Overflowing Coffers
perks.description: While you have stacks of Untold Greed, Orbs of Power and Elemental pickups provide more of their respective energy, and Strand Tangles deal increased damage. When your shields are broken, all stacks are converted into a fountain of Orbs of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有无尽贪婪层数时，能量球和元素拾取物会提供更多对应能量，并且提升缚丝缠结造成的伤害。当你的护盾被击破时，所有层数会转化为一股能量球的泉涌。

perks.name: Old Martian Diplomacy
perks.description: Stowing a weapon after defeating a powerful combatant or a Guardian heals you a small amount and disorients nearby combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 在击败一名强力战斗人员或守护者后收起武器，会为自身恢复少量生命值，并使附近战斗人员迷失方向。

perks.name: High Noon
perks.description: Freshly drawn weapons deal increased precision damage to combatants for a short period. Weapons with the Tex Balanced Stock Origin Trait equipped or Exotics manufactured by the Tex Mechanica Foundry gain further increased benefits.
perks.descriptionZh: 新拔出的武器在短时间内对战斗人员造成的精准伤害获得提升。装备特克斯平衡枪托原始特性的武器或由特克斯机械铸造厂制造的异域装备将获得进一步的提升。

perks.name: Built Bitter
perks.description: Taking damage increases the reload speed of your equipped weapon until it is stowed. Taking more damage increases the effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 受到伤害会提升你已装备武器的填装速度，直到收起该武器。受到更多伤害可提升此效果。

perks.name: Bittersweet
perks.description: When you stow a weapon, restore health based on the number of Built Bitter stacks lost.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你收起武器时，根据失去的苦涩锻造层数恢复生命值。

perks.name: The Ceremony
perks.description: Finishing combatants or reviving allies initiates a Lucent Hive ritual. While the ritual is active, gain increased Super stat.
perks.descriptionZh: 终结战斗人员或复活盟友会开始光明邪魔族仪式。仪式生效期间，提升超能属性。

perks.name: Lucent Swarm
perks.description: Collecting Orbs of Power extends the Ceremony. While it is active, ability final blows occasionally spawn allied Arc moths.
perks.descriptionZh: 收集能量球会延长典礼持续时间。典礼生效时，技能最后一击有几率生成友方电弧飞蛾。

perks.name: Stack 'Em Up
perks.description: Defeating targets with unique elemental damage grants a stacking bonus to Transcendence energy gains while Transcendence is inactive.
perks.descriptionZh: 超凡未生效时，以独特元素伤害击败目标会提供可叠加的超凡能量获取加成。

perks.name: Burn 'Em Down
perks.description: While Transcendence is active, using your grenade ability consumes all stacks of Stack 'Em Up to grant an escalating amount of grenade energy.
perks.descriptionZh: 超凡生效时，使用手雷技能会消耗所有“叠加起来”层数来获得递增的手雷能量。

perks.name: Taking Initiative
perks.description: Hitting combatants with melee attacks or Sword strikes grants a stack of Initiative, giving bonus handling and reload. Stacks decay slowly over time.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用近战攻击或刀剑打击命中战斗人员可获得主动出击层数，从而提升操控性和填装。层数会随时间缓慢衰减。

perks.name: Healing Initiative
perks.description: While you have Initiative, using your class ability creates a stationary healing aura. The aura gains increased healing based on the number of Initiative stacks.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有主动出击层数时，使用职业技能会生成一个位置固定的治疗光环。该光环的治疗量基于主动出击层数而提升。

perks.name: Primary Honing
perks.description: Increases handling and reload speed for Primary ammo weapons. Primary ammo weapons gain increased damage against non-boss combatants based on your Weapons stat.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升主弹药武器的操控性和填装速度。根据你的武器属性，提升主弹药武器对非首领战斗人员造成的伤害。

perks.name: Supercyclical
perks.description: Final blows while your Super is active refund Super energy when it ends.
perks.descriptionZh: 超能生效期间造成的最后一击将在超能结束后返还超能能量。

perks.name: Adrenal Rush
perks.description: Sprinting for a short time grants a period of improved reload speed and handling. Final blows extend this period.
perks.descriptionZh: 短暂冲刺会在一段时间内提升填装速度和操控性。最后一击可延长持续时间。

perks.name: Bountiful Munitions
perks.description: While Adrenal Rush is active, final blows grant Special Ammo progress. Final Blows against powerful combatants, Guardians, and Taken grants additional progress.
perks.descriptionZh: 肾上腺素亢奋生效期间，最后一击提供特殊弹药进度。对强力战斗人员、守护者及傀儡军团造成的最后一击可提供额外进度。

perks.name: Revving Up
perks.description: Fast movement builds up a charge that gradually increases your health regeneration speed. Once you are Fully Revved, sprinting grants Speed Booster.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速移动积累充能，逐渐提升你的生命值回复速度。全速轰鸣时，冲刺会提供速度加成。

perks.name: Dielectric Drift
perks.description: Sliding while Speed Booster is active jolts combatants in front of you.
perks.descriptionZh: 速度加成生效时，滑行将震颤你前方的战斗人员。

perks.name: Paroli
perks.description: Primary ammo weapons gain a bonus to flinch resistance after sliding.
perks.descriptionZh: 滑行后主弹药武器会获得抖动抗性加成。

perks.name: Martingale
perks.description: Your weapons gain a temporary increase to handling and aim-down-sights speed when an ally is defeated or you revive an ally.
perks.descriptionZh: 当盟友被击败或你复活盟友时，你的武器会获得暂时的操控性和瞄准速度提升。

perks.name: Opening Act
perks.description: Final blows with grenades grant Heat weapons bonus stability and vent speed and grant Primary ammo weapons bonus stability and reload speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用手雷造成最后一击会为热量武器提供稳定性和排气速度加成，并为主弹药武器提供稳定性和填装速度加成。

perks.name: Room Clearing
perks.description: Multiple final blows with Heat weapons or Primary ammo weapons grant bonuses to weapon and grenade stats and increased ammo generation for Heat weapons and Primary ammo weapons.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用热量武器或主弹药武器造成多次最后一击，会为武器和手雷属性提供加成，并提升热量武器和主弹药武器的弹药生成。

perks.name: Nightmarish Power
perks.description: Final blows to a challenging combatant or higher-ranked target grant Unstable Essence. When you have Unstable Essence, you receive grenade and melee stat bonuses.
perks.descriptionZh: 对强力战斗人员或高阶目标造成最后一击可获得不稳定精华。拥有不稳定精华时，你会获得手雷和近战属性加成。

perks.name: Nightmarish Resilience
perks.description: When you have Unstable Essence, rapid weapon damage or final blows heal you and begin health regeneration.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有不稳定精华时，你的快速武器伤害或最后一击会提供治疗并开启生命值回复。

perks.name: Fanfare
perks.description: Gain increased reload speed for the bottom half of your equipped weapon's magazine.
perks.descriptionZh: 你装备的武器弹匣剩余一半子弹时填装速度提升。

perks.name: Suros Harmony
perks.description: Reloading a weapon grants it a bonus to handling and reduces incoming flinch for a short time. Weapons with the SUROS Synergy Origin Trait are granted increased range instead.
perks.descriptionZh: 填装武器可在短时间内提升其操控性及减少受到的抖动。如果武器拥有SUROS协同原始特性，则改为提升射程。

perks.name: Well Prepared
perks.description: Picking up ammo grants Armor Charge. Grants a bonus to Health stat per Armor Charge you have.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取弹药提供护甲充能。每层护甲充能都会提供生命值属性加成。

perks.name: Down the Line
perks.description: Sustained damage on minibosses, Champions, and bosses increases weapon damage versus base and powerful combatants. Weapon final blows consume one stack each.
perks.descriptionZh: 对初级首领、勇士和首领造成持续伤害会提升对基础和强力战斗人员造成的武器伤害。每次造成武器最后一击时消耗一层。

perks.name: Balestra
perks.description:
Damaging a target with a Sword, Glaive, or any melee attack exhausts them. 

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用刀剑、偃月或任意近战攻击伤害目标会使其疲惫。

疲惫的目标造成的伤害会减少。

perks.name: Stesso Tempo
perks.description: Blocking attacks with a Sword or Glaive grants a short period of damage resistance against targets when you next drop your guard.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用刀剑或偃月格挡攻击后，下次解除格挡时，会在短时间内获得针对目标的伤害抗性。

perks.name: Special Relativity
perks.description: Picking up ammo reloads stowed Special weapons from reserves.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取弹药会从备弹中填装收起的特殊武器。

perks.name: Superluminal Motion
perks.description: After dealing damage with your Super, health and shields regenerate over time while you are in motion. Additional Super damage refreshes this effect.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用超能造成伤害后，你移动时会逐渐回复生命值和护盾。额外超能伤害可刷新此效果。

perks.name: Gift of the Ley Lines
perks.description: Rapidly defeating combatants with Void energy spawns a Void breach.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用虚空能量快速击败战斗人员会生成虚空裂口。

perks.name: Techeun's Foresight
perks.description: After collecting a Void breach, your next final blow with a Void weapon triggers a detonation. The detonation is more powerful if it is triggered quickly after collecting a Void breach.
perks.descriptionZh: 收集虚空裂口后，你下一次使用虚空武器造成的最后一击会触发爆炸。收集虚空裂口后迅速触发的爆炸更强力。

perks.name: Lucent Transmutation
perks.description: Performing a finisher on a combatant, or landing successive powered melee final blows, generates an Elemental pickup based on your Light subclass.
perks.descriptionZh: 对战斗人员执行终结技，或造成连续充能近战最后一击，会根据你的光能分支职业生成一个元素拾取物。

perks.name: Lucent Tithes
perks.description: Performing a finisher on powerful combatants heals you and generates loyal Void moths.
perks.descriptionZh: 对强力战斗人员执行终结技会获得治疗并生成忠于你的虚空飞蛾。

perks.name: Watchtower
perks.description: Precision final blows while aiming down sights grant damage resistance until you stop aiming down sights.
perks.descriptionZh: 瞄准时造成精准最后一击会提供伤害抗性，直至你停止瞄准。

perks.name: Field Expertise
perks.description:
Precision final blows with any weapon grant a stacking bonus to reload speed, target acquisition, and weapon damage against non-boss combatants for a short duration.

Weapon final blows with non-precision direct hits end this effect early.
perks.descriptionZh:
使用任意武器造成精准最后一击会提供可叠加的增益，在短时间内提升填装速度、目标捕获能力以及对非首领战斗人员造成的武器伤害。

造成非精准直接命中的武器最后一击将提前结束此效果。

perks.name: Bad Dreams
perks.description: Final blows versus subclass-debuffed targets have an escalating chance to spawn an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 对受到分支职业减益影响的目标造成最后一击有递增的几率生成能量球。

perks.name: Dream-Devourer
perks.description: Performing a finisher versus a powerful combatant grants Devour. While you have Devour, gain damage resistance versus combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 对强力战斗人员施展终结技可提供吞食。拥有吞食时，获得对战斗人员的伤害抗性。

perks.name: Primary Chain
perks.description: Primary ammo weapon final blows grant a stacking bonus to mobility and Primary weapon range and handling until you are defeated.
perks.descriptionZh: 主弹药武器最后一击会提供可叠加的增益，提升敏捷、主武器射程和操控性，直至你被击败。

perks.name: Sublime Transit
perks.description: Increases mobility and grants enhanced sprint speed and slide distance.
perks.descriptionZh: 提升敏捷并强化冲刺速度和滑行距离。

perks.name: Cursed Fist
perks.description: Melee final blows trigger a Cursed Thrall explosion.
perks.descriptionZh: 近战最后一击会触发一次诅咒怨魂爆炸。

perks.name: Power of the Son
perks.description: Being in combat for a duration grants progressively more flinch resistance and damage resistance versus combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 处于战斗中一段时间会逐渐获得更多对战斗人员的抖动抗性和伤害抗性。

perks.name: Stable Resonance
perks.description: Defeating a powerful combatant generates Stable Resonance, which grants damage resistance and increased weapon damage for the duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败强力战斗人员会生成稳定共振，在持续时间内提供伤害抗性和提升武器伤害。

perks.name: Resonance Redirection
perks.description: While you have Stable Resonance, continued weapon damage occasionally generates a resonance burst that damages and exhausts targets.
perks.descriptionZh: 拥有稳定共振时，持续造成武器伤害偶尔会产生共振爆发，伤害目标并使其疲惫。

perks.name: Ride Together, Die Together
perks.description: When you pick up an Orb of Power, gain a brief period of rapidly decaying damage reduction.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球时，你会获得短暂且快速衰减的伤害减免效果。

perks.name: Too Old for This
perks.description: Defeating a powerful combatant with a finisher grants you Special ammo progress and replenishes a small amount of health.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用终结技击败强力战斗人员可获得特殊弹药进度，并恢复少量生命值。

perks.name: Reflex Action
perks.description: Swapping to a Heat weapon, Submachine Gun, or Hand Cannon grants a short period of increased handling and accuracy. This effect is extended by dealing damage with that weapon.
perks.descriptionZh: 切换到热量武器、微型冲锋枪或手炮会在短时间内提升操控性和精度。使用该武器造成伤害可延长此效果。

perks.name: Hotshot
perks.description: Dealing final blows while Reflex Action is active grants a bonus to weapon stat and increases stability, reload, and aim assist for Heat weapons, Submachine Guns, and Hand Cannons for a moderate duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 在反射动作生效时造成最后一击会获得武器属性提升，并在一定时间内提升热量武器、微型冲锋枪和手炮的稳定性、填装和瞄准辅助。

perks.name: Pleas Heard
perks.description: Reloading an Auto Rifle, Scout Rifle, or Sidearm after a final blow slowly restores health until you reenter combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 造成最后一击后填装自动步枪、斥候步枪或手枪可缓慢恢复生命值，直至你重新进入战斗。

perks.name: Magnificent Duty
perks.description: When you reach critical health or heal an ally at critical health, Auto Rifles, Scout Rifles, and Sidearms gain a period of increased range, stability, and reload speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你陷入生命危急或治疗生命危急的盟友时，自动步枪、斥候步枪和手枪会暂时获得射程、稳定性和填装速度提升。

perks.name: Resupply
perks.description: After being out of combat for a moderate duration, your next final blow grants additional ammo progress and creates an Orb of Power.
perks.descriptionZh: 脱离战斗一定时间后，你的下一次最后一击提供额外弹药进度并生成一个能量球。

perks.name: From the Storm
perks.description: After being out of combat for a moderate duration, slowly gain Frost Armor until you reenter combat.
perks.descriptionZh: 脱离战斗一定时间后，缓慢获得冰霜护甲直到你再次进入战斗。

perks.name: Emergency Electromagnet
perks.description: When your shields become broken, collect all nearby Orbs of Power and ammo bricks.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的护盾被击破时，自动收集附近所有的能量球与弹药盒。

perks.name: Repurposed Charge
perks.description:
Whenever you gain, lose, or spend an Armor Charge, heal and gain damage reduction for a short time.

This effect scales with the amount of Armor Charge gained, lost, or spent.
perks.descriptionZh:
获得、失去或消耗护甲充能时，在短时间内获得治疗和伤害减免。

此效果根据获得、失去和消耗的护甲充能数量而调整。

perks.name: Terminal Velocity
perks.description: Final blows with primary ammo weapons grant your primary ammo weapons temporarily increased reload speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用主弹药武器造成最后一击会暂时提升主弹药武器的填装速度。

perks.name: Power Loader
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants Special ammo progress.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取能量球会提供特殊弹药进度。

perks.name: Crook and Flail
perks.description: Picking up an ammo brick heals you.
perks.descriptionZh: 拾取弹药盒会治疗你。

perks.name: Gift of Sight
perks.description: Final blows with Primary ammo weapons grant you briefly increased radar resolution.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用主弹药武器造成最后一击会暂时提升你雷达的分辨率。

perks.name: License to Thrill
perks.description: Activating your grenade or the Nanotech Tracer Missiles Origin Trait provides stacking resistance to incoming damage at point-blank range.
perks.descriptionZh: 激活手雷或纳米技术追踪导弹原始特性会为近距离来袭伤害提供可叠加的抗性。

perks.name: Lethal Weave
perks.description: Defeating an unraveled combatant grants grenade ability energy. If you have max grenade energy, you are granted Special ammo meter progress instead.
perks.descriptionZh: 击败被瓦解的战斗人员会提供手雷技能能量。如果你的手雷能量已充满，则获得特殊弹药量表进度。

perks.name: Augmented Armaments
perks.description: Primary ammo weapons deal increased damage to disoriented combatants.
perks.descriptionZh: 主弹药武器对迷失方向的战斗人员造成更高伤害。

perks.name: Augmented Explosives
perks.description: Your grenade abilities release an additional disorienting pulse shortly after detonating.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的手雷技能在爆炸不久后额外释放一次扰乱脉冲。

perks.name: Sinew Stitching
perks.description: Taking damage from combatants sometimes spawns a Threadling.
perks.descriptionZh: 受到来自战斗人员的伤害时可能生成一只线虫。

perks.name: Knit Together
perks.description: For a short time after your shields break, your next several Threadling hits restore health.
perks.descriptionZh: 你的护盾被击破后的短时间内，你接下来的几次线虫命中会回复生命值。

perks.name: Rapid Repair
perks.description: When your shields begin to regenerate, you gain flinch resistance and damage resistance for a short time.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你的护盾开始回复时，你在短时间内获得抖动抗性和伤害抗性。

perks.name: Built from Scratch
perks.description: While your reserves are low, combatant final blows with weapons provide additional ammo progress based on their ammo type.  Primary ammo weapons boost Special ammo progress, and Special ammo weapons boost Heavy ammo progress.
perks.descriptionZh: 当你的弹药储备较低时，使用武器对战斗人员造成最后一击，会根据武器弹药类型提供额外的弹药进度。主弹药武器可提升特殊弹药进度，特殊弹药武器可提升重型弹药进度。

perks.name: Photogalvanic
perks.description: Receiving healing temporarily grants your Solar weapons increased flinch resistance, handling, and reload speed.
perks.descriptionZh: 接受治疗时暂时为你的烈日武器提升抖动抗性、操控性和填装速度。

perks.name: Cauterize
perks.description: Rapid Solar final blows heal you.
perks.descriptionZh: 快速烈日最后一击会治疗你。

perks.name: Combat Meditation
perks.description: Sword hits return grenade and class energy. Bonus energy is granted if Blade Focus is active.
perks.descriptionZh: 刀剑命中返还手雷和职业能量。如果启用利刃专注，还将获得额外能量。

perks.name: Blade Focus
perks.description: Briefly guard with a Sword to ready Blade Focus. While Blade Focus is readied, hitting a target with your sword increases Sword damage and lunge distance for a moderate duration.
perks.descriptionZh: 使用刀剑短暂格档来让利刃专注就绪。利刃专注就绪时，用刀剑命中目标会在一定时间内提升刀剑伤害和前冲距离。

stats.name: Health
stats.description: Increases the amount of health you gain each time you pick up an Orb of Power. Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming a weapon.
stats.descriptionZh: 提升每次拾取能量球时获得的生命值。降低瞄准武器时因受到伤害而产生的抖动。

stats.name: Melee
stats.description: Reduces your melee cooldown. Increases the amount of melee energy from all sources.
stats.descriptionZh: 缩短近战的冷却时间，提升所有来源的近战能量。

stats.name: Grenade
stats.description: Reduces your grenade ability cooldown. Increases the amount of grenade energy from all sources.
stats.descriptionZh: 缩短手雷技能的冷却时间，提升所有来源的手雷能量。

stats.name: Class
stats.description: Reduces your class ability cooldown. Increases the amount of class ability energy provided by all sources.
stats.descriptionZh: 缩短职业技能的冷却时间，提升所有来源提供的职业技能能量。

stats.name: Super
stats.description: Increases the amount of Super energy from all sources.
stats.descriptionZh: 提升所有来源的超能能量。

stats.name: Weapons
stats.description: Increases weapon reload speed and handling. Increases weapon damage against minor and major combatants.
stats.descriptionZh: 提升武器填装速度和操控性。增强对次要和主要战斗人员的武器伤害。

mods.name: Heavy Ammo Finder
mods.description: Increases the effect of all contributions towards the Heavy ammo meter.
mods.descriptionZh: 提升对重型弹药量表的所有计入效果。

在拥有任何护甲充能时，你的动能武器会获得小幅额外伤害加成。你的护甲充能现在会逐渐衰减。

mods.name: Colossus Armorer
mods.description: Acquired armor pieces with randomized stats are more likely to drop with the Colossus archetype, which has Super as its primary stat and Health as its secondary.
mods.descriptionZh: 获取的随机属性护甲更有可能掉落装甲兵框架：超能为主要属性，生命值为次要属性。

mods.name: Special Ammo Scout
mods.description: When you fill your Special ammo meter, it also creates smaller bricks of Special ammo for your allies.
mods.descriptionZh: 当你填满特殊弹药量表时，也会为盟友生成较小的特殊弹药盒。

tooltipNotifications.displayString: Multiple copies of this mod stack, creating more ammo for your allies for each additional copy equipped.

mods.name: Reaper
mods.description: Shortly after using your class ability, your next weapon final blow spawns an Orb of Power.
mods.descriptionZh: 在使用你的职业技能后的短时间内，你的下一次武器最后一击会生成一个能量球。

tooltipNotifications.displayString: Equipping multiple copies of this mod increases the potency of the generated Orb and reduces the duration of the cooldown.

mods.name: Shield Break Charge
mods.description: Breaking a combatant's shield with the matching damage type grants you Armor Charge.
mods.descriptionZh: 用匹配的伤害类型击破战斗人员的护盾可获得护甲充能。

enabledRules.failureMessage: Requires Guardian Rank 7: Threats and Surges

mods.name: Solar Scavenger
mods.description: Solar weapons get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that weapon.
mods.descriptionZh: 拾取该烈日武器所用弹药时，获得额外弹药储量。

Gain damage resistance while you are standing on a plate, near a lantern or totem, or while you carry the relic Sword. Multiple copies of this mod stack to increase this benefit.
mods.descriptionZh:
此模组特性仅在“克洛塔的末日”突袭中生效。

多个此模组可以叠加和强化其效果。

站在石板上、在灯笼或图腾附近，或携带圣物刀剑时，可获得伤害抗性。此模组可叠加以增强效果。

mods.name: Empowered Finish
mods.description: Finisher final blows grant you 1 temporary Armor Charge when you have none.
mods.descriptionZh: 若你没有护甲充能，终结技最后一击会赋予1层临时的护甲充能。

mods.description: Increases reload speed of Strand weapons.

Empowered Weighted Knife is strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
traits.descriptionZh:
权衡飞刀可以弹跳两次。用你的武器获得快速精准命中可为权衡飞刀提供大幅伤害加成和近战加成，并且在短时间内眩晕没有护盾的战斗人员。

强化权衡飞刀克制势不可挡勇士。

traits.name: Barri-nade
traits.description: Using your class ability channels defensive Light inward, providing a grenade that creates a barricade on impact. Picking up Orbs of Power enhances your next Barri-nade, spawning more barricades on impact.
traits.descriptionZh: 使用你的职业技能会将防御性光能导向体内，提供一枚在命中时生成屏障的手雷。拾取能量球会强化你的下一次屏障手雷，命中时生成更多屏障。

traits.name: Starless Night
traits.description:
Weapons of Light persists after exiting Ward of Dawn. While Weapons of Light is active, final blows or sustained damage grant stacks of The Saint; Void and Kinetic damage sources also trigger a suppressing burst.
 
Picking up Ward of Dawn consumes all stacks of The Saint and extends its duration based on how many stacks were consumed.
traits.descriptionZh:
光之武器效果在离开黎明护罩后仍会持续。光之武器生效时，最后一击或持续伤害会提供圣人层数；虚空与动能伤害来源还会触发一次压制爆发。
 
拾取黎明护罩会消耗全部圣人层数，并根据消耗的层数延长其持续时间。

traits.name: Close Enough
traits.description: Damaging targets with Chaos Reach extends its duration. Collecting Ionic Traces grants you energy for Chaos Reach. Sprinting while near max Bolt Charge will grant stacks over time.
traits.descriptionZh: 使用混沌之触对目标造成伤害可延长它的持续时间。收集离子轨迹可提供混沌之触能量。接近电光充能最大层数时，冲刺会随时间提供层数。

traits.name: Grasp of the Devourer
traits.description:
Damaging a target with a melee inflicts potent corruption that deals increasing damage over time. Defeating targets afflicted by corruption spreads the condition.

Provides a moderate benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all Weapons of Sorrow.
traits.descriptionZh:
使用近战对目标造成伤害会施加强效腐化，随时间造成递增伤害。击败腐化的目标会扩散此状态。

中幅提高所有忧愁武器的空中效率属性。

traits.name: Hammer of the Gods
traits.description: Defeating targets with your Thunderclap melee restores melee energy. Targets near you when you use your Thunderclap suffer lightning strikes and become jolted; being amplified increases the damage of these lightning strikes.
traits.descriptionZh: 使用雷霆一击近战击败目标会恢复近战能量。使用雷霆一击时你附近的目标会遭受闪电打击并且被震颤；增幅状态会增加闪电打击的伤害。

traits.name: Null Factor
traits.description: Withering Blade hits and bounces create a small Stasis crystal and refund a portion of melee energy. Using Withering Blade to shatter crystals or frozen targets releases a spread of Withering Blades.
traits.descriptionZh: 枯萎之刃命中和弹跳会生成一个小冰影水晶并返还一部分近战能量。使用枯萎之刃击碎水晶或冻结目标会释放枯萎之刃。

traits.name: Roast 'Em
traits.description:
Your Proximity Knife scorches targets it damages with its explosions, or ignites targets on final blow.

After throwing a Proximity Knife, you gain increased melee regeneration until the knife explodes. Gain a small amount of melee energy when your Scorch damages a target, and Ignition final blows fully refund melee energy and can overflow into an additional knife charge.
traits.descriptionZh:
你的感应飞刀会灼烧爆炸时造成伤害的目标，或在最后一击时点燃目标。

在投掷感应飞刀后，你会在飞刀爆炸前获得更高的近战回复能力。当你用灼烧伤害目标时，获得少量近战能量，点燃最后一击会完全返还近战能量，并可满溢为额外的飞刀充能。

traits.name: Restorative Titan Armor
traits.description: Improved recovery.
traits.descriptionZh: 更强的恢复力。

traits.name: Mobile Titan Armor
traits.description: Improved mobility.
traits.descriptionZh: 更高的敏捷度。

traits.name: Wraithmetal Mail
traits.description: Your weapons ready quicker and are more stable. Dodging temporarily increases this benefit, reloads your equipped weapon from reserves, grants improved movement speed, and increases your class ability stat.
traits.descriptionZh: 进行闪身可填装所有武器，并在一小段时间内提高移动和武器操控速度。

traits.name: Synapse Junctions
traits.description: Quick successive attacks with Arc Staff increase its damage output, duration and jolt targets hit.
traits.descriptionZh: 使用电弧法杖快速连续攻击可提高伤害输出，延长持续时间，并震颤击中的目标。

traits.name: Tome of Dawn
traits.description: While you have a [Solar]Solar Super equipped, aiming weapons while you're midair suspends you there for a short time. While this effect is active, you are more resistant to incoming damage and combatants are less accurate. Weapon hits extend this effect's duration, and [Solar]Solar weapon final blows provide Restoration and reload your other weapons from reserves. Provides a large benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all weapons.
traits.descriptionZh: 装备烈日超能时，在空中瞄准可使你在短时间内滞留在半空中。当此效果生效时，你对伤害的抗性增加，战斗人员的精度下降。武器命中可延长此效果的持续时间，烈日武器最后一击可提供恢复，从储备弹药中填装其他武器。大幅提高所有武器的空中效率属性。

traits.name: Wish-Dragon Teeth
traits.description: Increases Tripmine Grenade duration and blast radius. Ability damage grants Tripmine Grenade energy.
traits.descriptionZh: 延长感应手雷的持续时间和爆炸范围。技能伤害可提高感应手雷的能量。

traits.name: Vanishing Shadow
traits.description: Increases the duration of any invisibility effects. When you gain invisibility, your grenade, melee and class abilities recharge faster. At maximum stacks, you gain a Void Overshield as well.
traits.descriptionZh: 提升所有隐身效果的持续时间。进入隐身状态时，你的手雷、近战和职业技能会更快地充能。达到最大叠加层数时，还将获得虚空覆盖护盾。

traits.name: Alchemical Etchings
traits.description: Increases hip-fire range and accuracy for Primary ammo weapons. Your Rifts gain the additional ability to increase weapon reload speeds. Empowering Rift makes weapons effective at longer ranges.
traits.descriptionZh: 提升主弹药武器的腰射射程和精度。你的裂痕可以增加武器的填装速度。强能裂痕使武器在较远距离下也有效。

traits.name: Probability Matrix
traits.description: Arcbolt Grenades have increased chaining capabilities and jolt targets hit. Damaging combatants with jolt or applying jolt to targets grants additional Arcbolt Grenade energy.
traits.descriptionZh: 电光手雷的连锁能力提升，震颤击中的目标。通过震颤伤害战斗人员或对目标施加震颤，可获得额外的电光手雷能量。

traits.name: Survival Well
traits.description: Generates an additional Orb of Power from Supers. Generating a Barricade, or dealing sustained damage or defeating targets from behind one creates a healing pulse. Healing your allies grants Barricade energy.
traits.descriptionZh: 超能可生成一颗额外的能量球。生成屏障、在屏障后造成持续伤害或击败目标时会产生一股具有治疗功能的脉冲。治疗盟友可提供屏障能量。

traits.name: Auto-Loading Link
traits.description: Steadily reloads a portion of your equipped Auto Rifle or Machine Gun's magazine from reserves. Final blows with Auto Rifles or Machine Guns boost their stability, ammo generation, and damage. Provides a moderate benefit to their airborne effectiveness.
traits.descriptionZh: 可从弹药储备中稳步填装已装备自动步枪或机枪的部分弹药。中幅提高自动步枪和机枪的空中效率属性。

traits.name: Sunfire Furnace
traits.description:
While your Solar Super is charged, ability final blows cure you and give stacks of Sunfire Furnace.

While Sunfire Furnace is active, grenade and Shieldburst final blows trigger an ignition. Each stack increases grenade regeneration, class ability regeneration, and Super damage. Upon exiting your Super, all stacks are converted into Super energy.
traits.descriptionZh:
你的烈日超能完成充能时，技能最后一击会治愈你并提供日焰熔炉层数。

日焰熔炉生效期间，手雷和盾爆最后一击会触发一次点燃。每层效果都会增加手雷回复、职业技能回复以及超能伤害。超能结束后，所有层数都会转化为超能能量。

traits.name: See Me, Feel Me
traits.description: Your Void weapons gain Volatile Rounds after you emerge from being invisible. When you are invisible and defeat a combatant while using a finisher, all of your weapons gain bonus damage; you and your nearby allies gain a reserve overshield and improved class ability regeneration. These reserve overshields can be deployed by using a class ability.
traits.descriptionZh: 你的虚空武器在你从隐身状态现身后会获得不稳定弹药。当你隐身并使用终结技击败一名战斗人员时，你所有的武器都会获得额外伤害；你和附近盟友将获得后备覆盖护盾和更快的职业技能回复速度。这些后备覆盖护盾可通过使用职业技能来部署。

traits.name: Overflowing Light
traits.description: Using an ability (grenade, melee, or Barricade) empowers the other two abilities. Empowered means abilities have faster regen, melees and grenades do more damage, and Barricades have more hit points.
traits.descriptionZh: 使用一个技能（手雷、近战或屏障）可为另外两个技能赋能。赋能意味着技能充能速度更快，近战和手雷可造成更多伤害，屏障可抵挡更多伤害。

traits.name: Light Shift
traits.description: While you have a Stasis or Arc Super equipped, your Dodge becomes a longer range, faster moving shift that partially cloaks you during use. After shifting, your Stasis and Arc weapons gain a stacking damage bonus for a short time. Final blows with this bonus active refund class ability energy.
traits.descriptionZh: 装备冰影或电弧超能时，你的闪身会变为一种长距离的快速位移，使用时你会获得部分隐身效果。位移后的短时间内，你的冰影和电弧武器会在短时间内获得可叠加的伤害加成。此加成生效时造成最后一击可返还职业技能能量。

traits.name: Solar Rampart
traits.description: Solar final blows recharge your Barricade. While you have a Solar Super equipped, casting your Barricade unleashes waves of Solar energy that damage and scorch targets. Combatants damaged and Guardians defeated by these waves are enveloped in a Sunspot.
traits.descriptionZh: 烈日最后一击会重新充能屏障。装备烈日超能时，施放屏障会释放出几道烈日能量波，伤害并灼烧目标。受到此类能量波伤害的战斗人员及被击败的守护者，会笼罩在太阳黑子中。

traits.name: Soaring Fusilier
traits.description: Air dodge reloads all of your weapons and improves the airborne effectiveness of Fusion Rifles and Linear Fusion Rifles; final blows with these weapons make you radiant. Provides a moderate benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of Fusion Rifles and Linear Fusion Rifles.
traits.descriptionZh: 空中闪避可重新填装所有武器，提升融合步枪和线性融合步枪的空中效率；使用这些武器完成最后一击将使你获得焕光效果。中幅提高融合步枪和线性融合步枪的空中效率属性。

traits.name: Devouring Rift
traits.description: While using a Void Super, casting an Empowering Rift will grant you Devour. Damage dealt by you and your allies from within your Empowering Rift will [Disruption] disrupt combatants. Defeating a target while Devour is active grants you class ability energy.
traits.descriptionZh: 使用虚空超能时，施放强能裂痕会赋予你吞食效果。你和你的盟友从强能裂痕中输出的伤害将扰乱战斗人员。吞食生效时击败目标会提供职业技能能量。

traits.name: Clenched Fist
traits.description: Maximizes guard stats on equipped Heavy ammo Swords. You take reduced damage while blocking with a Sword. Rapidly damaging targets after blocking shots with a Sword grants Restoration for a duration determined by the number of shots blocked.
traits.descriptionZh: 最大化装备中的重型弹药刀剑的格挡属性。使用刀剑格挡时，受到的伤害降低。使用刀剑阻挡射击后快速伤害目标可获得恢复，持续时间取决于阻挡的射击数。

traits.name: Friendly Competition
traits.description:
Defeating an enemy with an ability generates a Laurel. Picking up a Laurel of your class has a chance to grant an additional Laurel.

Completing Strikes, Crucible, or Gambit matches awards a Bronze Medal. Completing Nightfalls, Survival, or Trials matches awards a Silver Medal.
traits.descriptionZh:
用技能消灭敌人会生成桂冠。拾取与你的职业相同的桂冠有几率获得额外桂冠。

完成打击、熔炉竞技场或智谋比赛奖励一块铜牌。完成日落、生存模式或试炼比赛奖励一块银牌。

traits.name: Rapid Cooldown
traits.description:
Increases grenade, melee, and dodge regeneration while sprinting.

Gain stacks of Frost Armor while sprinting. When you have Frost Armor, Stasis weapons deal additional damage.
traits.descriptionZh:
在冲刺时提升手雷、近战与闪身的回复。

冲刺时获得冰霜护甲层数。当你拥有冰霜护甲时，冰影武器造成额外伤害。

traits.name: Blessing of Order
traits.description: Standing in a rift creates Noble Seekers that seek out allies and heal them. Standing in an empowering rift creates Noble Seekers that grant both you and your ally a damage bonus. When a Noble Seeker finds an ally, you gain class ability energy. Increases the airborne effectiveness stat of the Hand Cannon Lumina.
traits.descriptionZh: 站在裂痕之中可以产生寻找盟友并治愈他们的高贵追踪弹。站在强能裂痕之中可以产生赋予你和你的盟友伤害加成的高贵追踪弹。每当高贵追踪弹找到盟友时，你会获得职业技能能量。提升手炮流明的空中效率属性。

traits.name: Fusion Harness
traits.description: Fusion Grenades have an additional charge and recharge from empowered weapon damage, with empowered weapon final blows granting more energy. Defeating targets with Fusion Grenades grant Rift energy.
traits.descriptionZh: 获得额外的融合手雷充能，并可从赋能武器伤害中充能，且赋能武器最后一击可提供更多能量。使用融合手雷击败目标可提供裂痕能量。

traits.name: Relentless Tracker
traits.description: Damaging a powerful combatant or Guardian with an ability temporarily increases weapon damage of the same type. Defeating that marked target with damage that matches the element creates an Elemental pickup.
traits.descriptionZh: 使用技能对强力战斗人员或守护者造成伤害可暂时提升同种类型的武器伤害。使用与元素匹配的伤害击败该标记目标可生成一个元素拾取物。

traits.name: Adamantine Brace
traits.description: Bow perfect draw can be held indefinitely. Gain a bonus to the Bow's damage when released, based on how long perfect draw was held. Provides a moderate benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of Bows.
traits.descriptionZh: 弓箭可以不限时地完美拉弓。根据完美拉弓持续时间，箭矢在射出时会得到相应的伤害加成。中幅提高弓箭的空中效率属性。

traits.name: Sharp Edges
traits.description: Throwing Knife final blows decrease the cooldown of your Super. Hitting a single target with most Blade Barrage knives in a volley causes them to release a violent Solar explosion; releasing scorching Solar shrapnel. Hits and final blows with Blade Barrage will return Super energy after the Super ends.
traits.descriptionZh: 飞刀最后一击会减少超能的冷却时间。一轮齐射中被利刃弹幕飞刀命中最多的目标会释放一次剧烈的烈日爆炸，发射灼烧烈日碎片。使用利刃弹幕造成命中和最后一击将于超能结束后返还超能能量。

traits.name: Warlord's End
traits.description: Powered melee hits weaken targets. Powered melee final blows create a burst of energy that dramatically weakens nearby targets. Finishers and final blows against more powerful targets increase the radius of the burst and the length of the weakening effect.
traits.descriptionZh: 充能近战命中会削弱目标。充能近战最后一击可制造一次能量爆发，大幅削弱附近的敌人。对强大目标的终结技和最后一击会增加爆发的范围和削弱效果的持续时间。

traits.name: Force Multiplier
traits.description: Shotgun and melee final blows start your health regeneration. While you have a defensive buff (Void Overshield, Amplified, Restoration, Frost Armor, Woven Mail), your Shotguns and melees deal additional damage and final blows with either extend the duration of those buffs. Provides a moderate benefit to Shotgun airborne effectiveness and reload speed.
traits.descriptionZh: 霰弹枪和近战最后一击会为你开启生命值回复。拥有防御性增益（虚空覆盖护盾、增幅、恢复、冰霜护甲、织造铠甲）时，你的霰弹枪和近战造成额外伤害，且二者的最后一击都将延长增益持续时间。中幅提升霰弹枪的空中效率和填装速度。

traits.name: One with the Void
traits.description: Your Void Souls have a longer duration. They also gain escalating damage and durability as they defeat targets. You can retrieve your Void Souls by interacting with them, allowing them to be redeployed.
traits.descriptionZh: 你的虚空灵魂的持续时间延长。它们击败目标时会获得递增的伤害和耐久度。你可以通过与虚空灵魂互动来收回它们，以重新部署。

traits.name: Bring the Heat
traits.description: Fusion Grenades gain increased throw speed, explode on impact, and stun Unstoppable Champions. Final blows with Fusion Grenades grant grenade energy.
traits.descriptionZh: 融合手雷投掷速度提高，命中时发生爆炸，并可眩晕势不可挡勇士。融合手雷造成最后一击会提供手雷能量。

traits.name: Burning Fists
traits.description: Defeating a target with melee or a finisher grants escalating melee damage, which decays over time. Higher levels of Burning Fists grant increased weapon damage.
traits.descriptionZh: 使用近战攻击或终结技击败目标会提供不断增加的近战伤害，但此加成会随着时间衰减。更高等级的燃烧之拳会提供更高的武器伤害。

traits.name: Voltaic Mirror
traits.description: Guarding with your Arc Staff does not consume extra Super energy. [Super]  : Cancel Arc Staff early, temporarily increasing Arc weapon damage and creating a blinding burst. Reflected attacks increase the damage of the burst, extend your Super, and deal additional damage.
traits.descriptionZh: 使用你的电弧法杖进行防御不会消耗额外超能能量。[超能]  ：提前取消电弧法杖，暂时提升电弧武器伤害并产生致盲爆发。反射攻击会增加爆发伤害，延长你的超能持续时间，并造成额外伤害。

traits.name: Percussive Flames
traits.description: Modifies Burning Maul into a single, high-damage slam of your hammer that creates several cyclones of flame. Consecration's second slam creates a cyclone of flame.
traits.descriptionZh: 将燃烧锻锤转换为生成若干火焰旋风的高伤害猛击。神圣献祭的第二次猛击会生成一个火焰旋风。

traits.name: Move to Survive
traits.description:
With Blink equipped, use [Air Dodge]  while airborne to perform a Dark Blink.

Using Blink or Dark Blink grants Volatile Rounds. Blink travels farther, causes nearby targets to become volatile, and has a shorter cooldown. While your Nova Warp Super is active, Dark Blink does not cost Super energy. Provides a moderate benefit to airborne effectiveness for all weapons.
traits.descriptionZh:
装备瞬移时，可在空中使用[空中闪身]来施展暗影瞬移。

使用瞬移或暗影瞬移可获得不稳定弹药。瞬移距离更远并对你附近的目标施加不稳定，且冷却时间更短。新星折跃超能生效期间，暗影瞬移不会消耗超能能量。中幅提升所有武器的空中效率。

traits.name: Bleak Domain
traits.description: Your Bleak Watcher turrets are enhanced with extended range and are surrounded by Stasis crystals and a storm. While standing in the storm, you are granted icicles over time. Icicles activate when you fire your weapons, applying Slow to targets they hit.
traits.descriptionZh: 你的凄凉观察者炮台已强化，射程更远，周围将环绕冰影水晶和风暴。当站在风暴中时，你会持续获得冰锥。用武器射击可激活冰锥，并对命中目标施加减速效果。

traits.name: Warlord's Sigil
traits.description: Melee and finisher final blows increase melee damage. With maximum stacks, you gain vastly increased melee regeneration speed for a short time.
traits.descriptionZh: 近战和终结技最后一击会提升近战伤害。达到最大层数时，短时间内获得大幅提升的近战回复速度。

traits.name: Vampire's Caress
traits.description: Melee and finisher final blows instantly grant cure and provide restoration for a short duration.
traits.descriptionZh: 近战和终结技最后一击会立即提供治愈，并在短时间内提供恢复。

traits.name: Abyssal Extractors
traits.description: Void final blows increase ability energy recharge rate. Combatants affected by Soul Siphon are suppressed. Defeating suppressed targets grants more time to Abyssal Extractors.
traits.descriptionZh: 虚空最后一击可加快技能能量充能速度。受到灵魂虹吸影响的战斗人员将被压制。击败被压制的目标可为深海萃取提供更多时间。

traits.name: Cerebral Uplink
traits.description: Highlights priority targets and improves the regeneration speed of your grenade, melee, and Rift abilities. Provides a small benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all weapons.
traits.descriptionZh: 高亮显示首要目标并提高手雷、近战和裂痕技能的充能速度。小幅提高所有武器的空中效率属性。

traits.name: Conduction Tines
traits.description:
While you have an Arc ability equipped, Arc ability or Jolt final blows increase the recharge rate of your abilities and extend the duration of Stormtrance.

While you have Conduction Tines, Ionic Sentry creates a Storm Grenade when it deploys.
traits.descriptionZh:
装备电弧技能时，电弧技能或震颤最后一击可提高你技能的充能速度，并延长雷霆万钧的持续时间。

拥有传导叉齿时，离子哨兵在部署时会生成一枚风暴手雷。

traits.name: Helium Spirals
traits.description: Increases the duration of Solar Grenades. Solar melee kills grant unlimited Solar Grenade energy for a brief time.
traits.descriptionZh: 延长烈日手雷的持续时间。完成烈日近战击杀可在短时间内提供无限烈日手雷能量。

traits.name: Scissor Fingers
traits.description: Gain a second knife per charge. Getting a final blow with a throwing knife grants consecutive knives a temporary stacking damage bonus. Gambler's Dodge refreshes the bonus timer.
traits.descriptionZh: 每次充能提供一把额外飞刀。使用飞刀造成最后一击时，连续投掷的飞刀会获得临时叠加伤害加成。赌徒闪身会重置加成倒计时。

traits.name: Dearly Departed
traits.description: Your Rift provides damage reduction to allied Guardians standing in it. Grants Rift energy when you are critically wounded. On your death, creates a healing rift on your corpse.
traits.descriptionZh: 裂痕会为站在其中的友方守护者提供伤害减免效果。身受重伤时可获得裂痕能量。死亡时，尸体会在短时间内产生具有治疗效果的裂痕。

traits.name: Feast of Light
traits.description: You gain additional Super energy from Orbs of Power you pick up. While your Super energy is full, picking up an Orb of Power overcharges your Super, causing you to gain a burst of healing when cast and a bonus to your Super damage. At maximum overcharge, you also gain an overshield.
traits.descriptionZh: 你可以从拾取的能量球中获得额外的超能能量。当你的超能能量已满时，拾取能量球来过载充能你的超能，从而在释放时获得爆发治疗效果并额外提升超能伤害。当达到最大过载充能时，你还能获得覆盖护盾。

traits.name: Stylostixis
traits.description: Targets damaged by Arcane Needle emit a suspending detonation when defeated. Landing multiple Arcane Needles or Needlestorm on the same target immediately triggers a larger, more powerful detonation. Defeating suspended targets grants melee energy. Your Arcane Needles are strong against [Shield-Piercing]Barrier Champions.
traits.descriptionZh: 受到神秘织针伤害的目标被击败时会触发悬停爆炸。用神秘织针或织针风暴多次命中同一目标可立即触发一次更大更强力的爆炸。击败被悬停的目标会提供近战能量。你的神秘织针克制屏障勇士。

traits.name: Actual Grandeur
traits.description:
After casting a Nova Bomb, briefly gain a free cast of a fast-moving but weaker Nova Bomb: Lance. Your Nova Bomb: Cataclysm is empowered if detonated with another Nova Bomb. 
Nova Bomb final blows and weapon final blows while you have Devour grant Super energy.
traits.descriptionZh:
在施放新星炸弹后，会在短时间内获得一次免费施放快速但弱化的新星炸弹：长矛的机会。若你的新星炸弹：灾变与另一枚新星炸弹一同引爆，将会得到强化。
拥有吞食时，新星炸弹最后一击和武器最后一击会提供超能能量。

traits.name: Fury Conductors
traits.description: Melee hits grant Armor Charge, and you take less melee damage from combatants while you have Armor Charge. Taking melee damage causes you to emit a burst of damaging Arc energy that jolts targets, consuming your Armor Charge and dealing more damage based on the number of stacks consumed.
traits.descriptionZh: 近战命中会获得护甲充能，在你拥有护甲充能时，战斗人员对你造成的近战伤害减少。受到近战伤害会让你爆发出一股伤害性电弧能量，能震颤目标，消耗护甲充能并基于消耗的层数造成更多伤害。

traits.name: New Tricks
traits.description: Gain an additional Skip Grenade charge. Skip Grenade damage grants Bolt Chargeand gaining Bolt Charge grants Skip Grenade energy. When Bolt Charge is ready, you heal nearby allies and enhance your next Skip Grenade.
traits.descriptionZh: 获得一发额外的弹跳手雷充能。弹跳手雷造成伤害会提供电光充能，获得电光充能会提供弹跳手雷能量。电光充能准备就绪时，你会治疗附近的盟友并强化你的下一发弹跳手雷。

traits.name: Linear Actuators
traits.description: Increases sprint speed. Sprinting builds up a static charge. After melee-attacking a combatant, that charge will chain damage to nearby foes. Gain Bolt Charge per target hit by the chain.
traits.descriptionZh: 提升冲刺速度。冲刺可积累一次静电充能。近战攻击战斗人员后，该充能将对附近敌人造成连锁伤害。每有一个目标被连锁伤害击中，即可获得电光充能。

traits.name: Misdirection
traits.description: Dodging disorients nearby enemies and temporarily removes their radar.
traits.descriptionZh: 闪身可迷惑附近的敌人并暂时关闭他们的雷达。

traits.name: Double Dodge
traits.description: Gain a second dodge charge. Shortly after dodging, your next weapon final blow spawns an Orb of Power.
traits.descriptionZh: 获得一次额外的闪身充能。在闪身后的短时间内，你的下一次武器最后一击会生成一个能量球。

traits.name: Roving Assassin
traits.description:
Each Spectral Blades hit or final blow you make before becoming invisible will restore more of your Super energy.

Exiting invisibility while near a target creates a cloud of weakening smoke around you.
traits.descriptionZh:
在你进入鬼灵利刃隐形状态前，你的每次命中或最后一击都会恢复更多的超能能量。

在靠近目标时离开隐形状态，会在你周围产生一团削弱烟雾。

traits.name: Blastwave Striders
traits.description: Gain resistance to your explosives. Defeat targets to charge this armor. Once charged, land a Shiver Strike melee attack or deal explosive self-damage to rocket jump backward and release a blast wave with deadly shrapnel projectiles. The wave freezes combatants and slows Guardians. Charged rocket jumps grant Frost Armor.
traits.descriptionZh: 获得对你的爆炸物的抗性。击败目标来为此护甲充能。充能后，进行战栗打击近战攻击或造成爆炸自我伤害，来向后火箭跳并释放带有致命碎片射弹的冲击波。冲击波会使战斗人员冻结并使守护者减速。充能火箭跳会提供冰霜护甲。

traits.name: Assault Barricade
traits.description: You and allies can shoot through your Towering Barricade. Your Towering Barricade takes increased damage from Guardians.
traits.descriptionZh: 你和盟友可以穿过你的巍峨屏障进行射击。你的巍峨屏障受到的守护者伤害会增加。

traits.name: Parting Gift
traits.description:
Dodging leaves behind an explosive that detonates after a short delay, damaging targets around it and creating a secondary effect based on your Super's element:
• [Arc] Blinds targets.
• [Solar] Scorches targets.
• [Void] Suppresses targets.
• [Stasis] Slows targets.
• [Strand] Severs targets.
traits.descriptionZh:
闪身会在原地留下一个延时引爆的爆炸装置，对周围目标造成伤害并基于你的超能元素施加次级效果：
•  致盲目标。
•  灼烧目标。
•  压制目标。
•  减速目标。
•  割裂目标。

traits.name: Vengeance
traits.description: Highlights the target who dares to damage you. Track down and destroy them for an overshield.
traits.descriptionZh: 高亮胆敢对你造成伤害的目标。追踪并消灭他们以获得覆盖护盾。

traits.name: Halberdier's Reach
traits.description: Increases Glaive reload speed and melee damage when surrounded. Glaive melee final blows overflow a round to the magazine. Glaive projectile final blows detonate in an explosion.
traits.descriptionZh: 被包围时，提高偃月的填装速度和近战伤害。偃月近战最后一击会在弹匣中溢装一发子弹。偃月射弹最后一击会引起爆炸。

traits.name: Upgraded Sensor Pack
traits.description: Provides radar while you're aiming. Enhances your radar resolution while crouched. Visually marks targets. Deals more damage to low-health marked targets. Provides a small benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all weapons.
traits.descriptionZh: 瞄准时可显示雷达。强化蹲伏时雷达的分辨率。从视觉上标记目标。对低生命值已标记目标造成更多伤害。小幅提高所有武器的空中效率属性。

traits.name: Hawkeye Hack
traits.description: Precision final blows reduce the cooldown of your Super. Modifies Golden Gun to fire a single, high-damage shot. Targets defeated by that shot give you Super energy and explode.
traits.descriptionZh: 精准最后一击会减少超能的冷却时间。将黄金枪改造为单发高伤害武器。被其击败的目标会给你超能能量并爆炸。

traits.name: Glacial Fortification
traits.description: While you have a Stasis Super equipped, your Barricade becomes a wall of Stasis crystals that slows nearby targets when created. Standing behind this barricade will grant you and your allies increased weapon reload speed, stability, and range.
traits.descriptionZh: 装备冰影超能时，你的屏障出现后会变成一堵由冰影水晶构成的，能减缓周围目标速度的墙壁。站在该屏障后方时，你和你的盟友会获得武器填装速度、稳定性以及射程提升。

traits.name: Spheromatik Trigger
traits.description: Powered melee final blows unleash a damaging explosion. Finishers and final blows against more powerful targets increase the radius and damage of the explosion.
traits.descriptionZh: 充能近战最后一击可制造一次爆炸。终结技和对强大敌人的最后一击可增加爆炸的伤害与范围。

traits.name: Myrmidon's Reach
traits.description: Gain a second charge of your Shield Throw melee. Your Shield Throws now weaken targets, create a Void Breach on final blows, and become shield-piercing, stunning [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions and refunding a Shield Throw charge when you do. Picking up a Void Breach grants you Shield Throw energy.
traits.descriptionZh: 获得第二次圣盾投掷近战充能。圣盾投掷现在会削弱目标，并在最后一击时生成一个虚空裂口；具备护盾穿透能力，可眩晕屏障勇士，且在眩晕成功时返还一次圣盾投掷充能。拾取虚空裂口可提供圣盾投掷能量。

traits.name: The Gift of Certainty
traits.description: Activating Ascension or Tempest Strike throws bouncing explosives at nearby targets that jolt and damage them. Jolting nearby targets grants you damage resistance.
traits.descriptionZh: 激活飞升或裂空打击会朝附近目标投掷出不断弹跳的爆炸物，震颤敌人并对其造成伤害。震颤附近目标可为你提供伤害抗性。

traits.name: Firewalker
traits.description: Increase the damage of Solar weapons and Solar Ignitions based on the amount of Roaring Flames stacks you have. You are harder to suspend, slow, or freeze, and when you break out, you take no damage from doing so, creating a burst of Solar energy around yourself.
traits.descriptionZh: 基于你拥有的咆哮烈焰层数，提升烈日武器和烈日点燃的伤害。你更难被悬停、减速或冻结。破除异常状态时，你不会受伤，且会同时在身体周围产生一波烈日能量冲击。

traits.name: Glacial Guard
traits.description: While you have a Stasis Super equipped, rapid Stasis final blows grant Frost Armor. You heal a small amount whenever you gain Frost Armor. Replaces your class ability with a burst of Stasis energy that freezes nearby combatants, slows nearby opponents, and grants you increased Frost Armor.
traits.descriptionZh: 当你装备冰影超能时，快速冰影最后一击会提供冰霜护甲。你获得冰霜护甲时回复少量生命值。将你的职业技能替换成冰影能量爆发，它会冻结附近战斗人员，减速附近对手，并为你提供更强的冰霜护甲。

traits.name: Malevolent Grasp
traits.description: While a Strand Super is equipped, casting Rift will suspend nearby combatants. Suspend deals damage over time, which heals you in the process. Targets who break free from suspension suffer additional damage. Defeating suspended targets heals you a moderate amount.
traits.descriptionZh: 装备缚丝超能时，施放裂痕会悬停附近的战斗人员。悬停会造成持续伤害，并在此过程中治疗你。目标挣脱悬停后会受到额外伤害。击败被悬停的目标会为你恢复适量生命值。

traits.name: Ursine Guard
traits.description: Move faster while guarding with Sentinel Shield or the Unbreakable shield. Damage blocked with Sentinel Shield is converted to Super energy, and damage blocked with Unbreakable is converted to grenade energy.
traits.descriptionZh: 使用哨兵圣盾或坚不可摧护盾防卫时移动速度更快。使用哨兵圣盾抵挡的伤害都会转化为超能能量，而使用坚不可摧抵挡的伤害都会转化为手雷能量。

traits.name: Beacons of Empowerment
traits.description: Sol Invictus lasts twice as long. Allies who pass through your Sunspot are granted Sol Invictus and Restoration. Dealing sustained [Solar]Solar damage in a Sunspot extends the duration of the Sunspot. Applying Solar buffs to allies has a chance to create a Sunspot at your feet.
traits.descriptionZh: “无敌索尔”增益的持续时间加倍。经过你的太阳黑子的盟友会获得无敌索尔和恢复增益。在太阳黑子内造成持续烈日伤害可延长太阳黑子持续时间。为盟友施加烈日增益时有几率在脚下生成太阳黑子。

traits.name: Resolute
traits.description: [Arc]Arc final blows grant an escalating damage bonus with Arc weapons. While using Fist of Havoc, activating your Super grants an overshield; final blows extend its duration. When it ends, gain a damage bonus to your Arc weapons.
traits.descriptionZh: 电弧最后一击可为电弧武器提供递增的伤害加成。使用浩劫之拳时，激活超能会提供覆盖护盾，最后一击可延长其持续时间。在结束时，可获得电弧武器伤害加成。

traits.name: Nightmare Fuel
traits.description: Powered melee and finisher final blows grant Nightmare Fuel, increasing handling and airborne effectiveness. While active, freshly drawn weapons deal additional damage and grant Nightmare Fuel on final blows. Gaining Nightmare Fuel reloads all holstered weapons.
traits.descriptionZh: 充能近战和终结技最后一击会提供噩梦激励，提升操控性和空中效率。生效时，新拔出的武器会造成额外伤害并在造成最后一击时提供噩梦激励。获得噩梦激励会填装所有枪套中的武器。

traits.name: The Dance
traits.description:
Moderately increases airborne effectiveness and hip fire mobility, range, and accuracy for weapons that use Primary ammo.

Final blows with Primary ammo weapons return dodge energy, which can overflow to create additional charges when full.
traits.descriptionZh:
适度提高主弹药武器的空中效率、腰射时的敏捷、射程和精度。

使用主弹药武器完成最后一击可返还闪身能量，能量满格时可以溢出生成额外的充能。

traits.name: Planetary Torrent
traits.description: Rifts periodically release Arc shockwaves. Final blows with these shockwaves create an Arc explosion. While an Arc Super is equipped, the shockwaves and subsequent explosions blind nearby targets. Rift energy recharges faster when you are surrounded by targets.
traits.descriptionZh: 裂痕会定期释放电弧冲击波。用这些冲击波施放最后一击会造成一次电弧爆炸。装备电弧超能时，冲击波及其后续的爆炸会致盲附近的目标。裂痕能量在你被目标包围时充能更快。

traits.name: Spring-Loaded Mounting
traits.description: Increases Sidearm airborne effectiveness, ready speed, and reload speed. While you're critically wounded, swapping to a Sidearm reloads it and increases its damage. While this effect is active, Sidearm final blows reload the weapon and extend the effect's duration.
traits.descriptionZh: 提高手枪的空中效率、举枪速度和填装速度。身受重伤时切换至手枪可立即填装并提高其伤害。当此效果生效时，手枪最后一击会填装武器并延长效果的持续时间。

traits.name: Ascending Amplitude
traits.description: Stormtrance hits and final blows increase the damage it deals. Refunds Super energy when it ends. While Stormtrance is equipped, ability damage while amplified grants Bolt Charge.
traits.descriptionZh: 雷霆万钧命中和最后一击会提升其造成的伤害。技能结束后返还超能能量。装备雷霆万钧时，处于增幅状态下造成技能伤害可获得电光充能。

traits.name: Tight Fit
traits.description: Dodging instantly reloads all your weapons and grants increased reload and handling to you and nearby allies. While the buff is active, additional dodges increase the buff strength and refresh the timer, maxing out at 5 stacks. Dealing sustained damage grants class ability energy.
traits.descriptionZh: 闪身会立即填装你的所有武器并提升你和附近盟友的填装和操控性。此增益生效时，额外的闪身会提升增益强度并刷新计时器，5层时达到上限。造成持续伤害会提供职业技能能量。

traits.name: Ionic Conductor
traits.description: Ionic traces you create move faster and grant you additional ability energy. Nearby allies also gain ability energy when you collect an ionic trace.
traits.descriptionZh: 你制造的离子轨迹移动更快，而且会提供额外的技能能量。在你收集到离子轨迹时，附近的盟友也会获得技能能量。

traits.name: Chaotic Exchanger
traits.description: Resist incoming damage while charging your Void grenade with Chaos Accelerant. Charged Void grenades return grenade energy on a hit and apply Weaken.
traits.descriptionZh: 使用混沌加速为你的虚空手雷充能时，可抵挡受到的伤害。充能完毕的虚空手雷在命中及施加削弱时会返还手雷能量。

traits.name: Danger Close
traits.description: Weapon precision hits or final blows have a chance to load a Kinetic Exodus micro-missile. Activating your class ability fires loaded Exodus micro-missiles. Damaging targets with Exodus micro-missiles temporarily increases the damage you deal with other micro-missiles and Rocket Launchers.
traits.descriptionZh: 武器精准命中或最后一击有几率装填一枚动能移民号微型导弹。激活你的职业技能来发射填装的移民号微型导弹。使用移民号微型导弹伤害目标会暂时提升你使用其他微型导弹和火箭发射器造成的伤害。

traits.name: Beyond The Veil
traits.description: You gain a second Smoke Bomb charge and have damage resistance while invisible. When you make an ally invisible, they gain damage resistance while invisible and you gain melee energy.
traits.descriptionZh: 你获得额外一次烟雾弹充能，并且在隐形时获得伤害抗性。当你使队友隐形时，他们会在隐形时获得伤害抗性，你还会获得近战能量。

traits.name: Kintsugi
traits.description: Final blows from weapons with a damage type matching your Super create a burst of healing around you that grants allies restoration. After reviving or being revived, you gain an aura that provides overshields to you and nearby allies.
traits.descriptionZh: 使用伤害类型与你的超能匹配的武器造成最后一击会在你周围产生爆发治疗，为盟友提供恢复。在复活或被复活后，你会获得一个光环，为你和附近盟友提供覆盖护盾。

traits.name: Swarmers
traits.description: Destroying a Tangle spawns a Threadling. Your Threadlings unravel targets that they damage.
traits.descriptionZh: 摧毁缠结会生成一个线虫。你的线虫会瓦解它们所伤害到的目标。

traits.name: Hearts of Ice
traits.description: Targets frozen by your Winter's Wrath Super take increased Shatter damage. Allies in range of your Winter's Wrath shockwave and Frostpulse gain Frost Armor and deal increased damage with Stasis weapons. Granting these buffs to allies grants you Super energy.
traits.descriptionZh: 被你的严冬之怒超能冻结的目标会受到更多碎裂伤害。在严冬之怒冲击波和冰霜脉冲范围内的盟友会获得冰霜护甲，并可使用冰影武器造成更多伤害。提供盟友这些增益会为你提供超能能量。

traits.name: Depths of Duskfield
traits.description: Your Duskfield grenades have a much larger effect radius. Allies inside the Duskfield gain Frost Armor and targets inside the area deal reduced damage.
traits.descriptionZh: 使你的暮域手雷的影响范围大幅增加。处于暮域内的盟友会获得冰霜护甲，并且该区域内的目标造成的伤害会减少。

traits.name: Vanishing Execution
traits.description: Powered melee final blows grant invisibility and restore a portion of health and shields. Finishers and final blows against more powerful targets increase the duration of the invisibility and the amount of health and shields restored.
traits.descriptionZh: 充能近战最后一击将赋予隐身并回复一部分生命值与护盾。终结技和对强大敌人的最后一击将增加隐身的时间与回复护盾及生命值的数量。

traits.name: Peregrine Strike
traits.description: All shoulder charge abilities (Seismic Strike, Hammer Strike, or Shield Bash) deal bonus damage when activated in the air. Damaging mini-bosses, Tormentors, or Champions with your shoulder charge refunds your melee. Provides a small benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all weapons.
traits.descriptionZh: 所有肩部冲撞技能（地震打击、战锤打击和圣盾强袭）在空中激活时会造成额外伤害。使用肩部冲撞对初级首领、折磨者或勇士造成伤害会返还你的近战能量。小幅提高所有武器的空中效率属性。

traits.name: Mobius Conduit
traits.description: Activating Gathering Storm calls down lightning on all nearby targets, jolting them while also amplifying allies. Defeating Arc debuffed targets grants a small amount of Gathering Storm energy.
traits.descriptionZh: 激活风起云涌会召唤闪电攻击附近所有目标，震颤他们的同时增幅盟友。击败受到电弧减益的目标会提供少量的风起云涌能量。

traits.name: Spirit of the Necrotic
traits.description: Damaging a target with a melee inflicts potent corruption. Defeating targets afflicted by corruption spreads the condition.
traits.descriptionZh: 使用近战对目标造成伤害会施加强效腐化。击败腐化的目标会扩散此状态。

tooltipNotifications.displayString: This randomly rolled perk will only be active while a Prismatic subclass is equipped.

traits.name: Spirit of the Swarm
traits.description: Destroying a Tangle spawns Threadlings.
traits.descriptionZh: 摧毁缠结会生成线虫。

tooltipNotifications.displayString: This randomly rolled perk will only be active while a Prismatic subclass is equipped.

traits.name: Rites of Ember
traits.description: Your Daybreak projectiles ignite targets on impact. Your Scorch deals additional damage, and builds to more powerful Ignitions. Dealing damage with Scorch or Ignitions grants melee energy.
traits.descriptionZh: 你的黎明射弹在命中时会点燃目标。你的灼烧造成额外伤害，并积累为更强力的点燃。用灼烧或点燃造成伤害会提供近战能量。

traits.name: Glorious Charge
traits.description: Greatly increases your Thundercrash damage and grants you damage resistance after impact. Melee final blows while amplified grant you Super energy.
traits.descriptionZh: 显著提升你的雷霆冲击伤害并在命中后为你提供伤害抗性。增幅时的近战最后一击会为你提供超能能量。

traits.name: Double Down
traits.description: Your Threaded Specter has increased duration and durability, and damaging it releases additional Threadlings. While near your Threaded Specter, you do not appear on radar.
traits.descriptionZh: 你的线织幽灵的持续时间与耐久度提升，对其造成伤害会释放出额外的线虫。在你的线织幽灵附近时，你不会出现在雷达上。

traits.name: High Priority
traits.description: Steadily reloads a portion of your equipped Trace Rifle's magazine from reserves. Damaging a vehicle, boss, or Champion with a Trace Rifle marks them as the target. When an ally defeats the marked target, Special ammo is generated for you and Heavy ammo for your allies.
traits.descriptionZh: 用备弹匀速向装备中的追踪步枪弹匣填装部分子弹。用追踪步枪伤害载具、首领或勇士，会将其标记为目标。当一名盟友击败已标记的目标时，会为你生成特殊弹药并为你的盟友生成重型弹药。

traits.name: Blood Magic
traits.description: While standing in any rift, damaging a target will mark it. You deal extra damage to marked targets, and gain additional bonus damage with weapons that have a damage type matching your equipped Super. Weapon final blows while standing in any rift pause the rift's countdown, extending its duration.
traits.descriptionZh: 站在任意裂痕中时，伤害目标会进行标记。你对标记的目标造成额外伤害，使用伤害类型与你已装备超能匹配的武器可获得额外伤害加成。站在任意裂痕中的武器最后一击会暂停裂痕的倒计时，从而延长其持续时间。

traits.name: The Fourth Magic
traits.description: Weapon final blows with a damage type matching your grenade grant Death Throes, which provide a grenade damage bonus and grant you grenade energy. When you have Death Throes and throw a grenade, nearby allies gain greatly increased grenade regeneration for a short time.
traits.descriptionZh: 用伤害类型与你的手雷匹配的武器造成最后一击会赋予死亡阵痛，使你的手雷获得伤害加成并提供手雷能量。当你拥有死亡阵痛并投掷手雷时，附近的盟友会在短时间内获得大幅手雷回复速度提升。

traits.name: Fervid Coldsnap
traits.description: Your Coldsnap grenades have an additional charge that recharges quicker on hits. The seeker spawned from Coldsnap grenades travels farther.
traits.descriptionZh: 你的急冻手雷有一发额外充能且命中时充能更快。急冻手雷产生的追踪弹移动得更远。

traits.name: Burning Souls
traits.description: Activating your class ability grants Cure. Rapid [Solar]Solar final blows grant stacks of Burning Souls that increase Solar ability damage, increase the potency of Dodge's healing, and spreads the healing to nearby allies.
traits.descriptionZh: 激活职业技能会提供治愈。快速烈日最后一击提供燃烧之魂层数，从而增加烈日技能的伤害、提升闪身治疗的效力，并将治疗扩散至附近的盟友。

traits.name: Webcatcher
traits.description: Threaded Spike can bounce to Tangles, detonating them and returning immediately. Tangles detonated by Threaded Spike are rewoven and retrieved by it. Catches without a Tangle refund extra melee energy.
traits.descriptionZh: 线织尖刺可弹射至缠结上，引爆后立即返回。被线织尖刺引爆的缠结会被重新编织并回收。无缠结的捕获会返还额外近战能量。

traits.name: Absorption Cells
traits.description: Final blows or sustained damage with weapons matching your equipped Super damage type grant you Super energy. When your Super energy is full, you instead gain a temporary bonus to weapon damage of that type. When you've exhausted your Super, matching elemental weapons' damage temporarily causes explosions around the target.
traits.descriptionZh: 使用与你已装备超能的伤害类型匹配的武器造成最后一击或持续伤害会为你提供超能能量。当你的超能能量已满时，你转而获得该类型的武器伤害临时加成。当你的超能能量耗尽时，使用与元素匹配的武器造成伤害会在短时间内在目标周围引发爆炸。

traits.name: Cross Counter
traits.description: Using your Arc melee ability or being hit by a melee attack will allow you to follow up with an extremely powerful melee counterpunch that will heal you.
traits.descriptionZh: 使用电弧近战技能或被近战攻击击中将使你进行一个相当强大的近战反击，同时对你进行治疗。

traits.name: Spirit of the Dragon
traits.description: Your weapons ready quicker and are more stable. Using your class ability temporarily increases this benefit and reloads your equipped weapon from reserves.
traits.descriptionZh: 你的武器准备得更快且更稳定。使用你的职业技能会暂时提升此加成，并从储备弹药中填装当前装备的武器。

tooltipNotifications.displayString: This randomly rolled perk will only be active while a Prismatic subclass is equipped.

traits.name: Spirit of the Cyrtarachne
traits.description: Gain Woven Mail when you use your grenade.
traits.descriptionZh: 使用手雷时会获得织造铠甲。

tooltipNotifications.displayString: This randomly rolled perk will only be active while a Prismatic subclass is equipped.

traits.name: And Another Thing
traits.description: Gain an additional grenade charge. Grenade final blows spawn an Orb of Power. Weapon final blows grant grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads your equipped weapon from reserves.
traits.descriptionZh: 获得一次额外的手雷充能。手雷最后一击会生成一个能量球。武器最后一击可提供手雷能量。使用手雷技能将从弹药储备中填装当前装备的武器。

traits.name: Lancer's Vigil
traits.description: While a Stasis Super is equipped, rapid Stasis weapon damage or damage from behind your Rally Barricade will create a Diamond Lance near you. Thrown Diamond Lances create Stasis crystals. Your Diamond Lances deal more damage based on how much Frost Armor you have.
traits.descriptionZh: 装备冰影超能时，快速冰影武器伤害或从集结屏障后造成伤害将在你附近生成钻石长矛。投掷的钻石长矛会生成冰影水晶。你的钻石长矛会根据你拥有的冰霜护甲层数造成更多伤害。

traits.name: Forge Master
traits.description: Collecting a Firesprite or rapid Solar final blows make you a Forge Master, allowing you to recall your Throwing Hammer. After impacting a target, recall your hammer at full intensity to perform a Perfect Recall, causing an explosion of forge slag. Perfect Recalls and collecting Firesprites extend your time as a Forge Master.
traits.descriptionZh: 收集焰灵或造成快速烈日最后一击会让你成为锻造大师，使你能召回投掷飞锤。命中目标后，以最大强度召回飞锤，即可施展完美召回，引发熔渣爆炸。完美召回及收集焰灵会延长你的锻造大师状态时间。

traits.name: Dynamic Duo
traits.description: [Grenade]  : Convert your Arc grenade into a Arc Soul and become amplified. The Arc Soul functions as an autonomous turret.
traits.descriptionZh: [手雷]  ：将你的电弧手雷转换成电弧之魂，并使你进入增幅状态。电弧之魂的作用相当于一个自动炮台。

traits.name: Cauterizing Flame
traits.description: While you have a Solar Super equipped, casting your Barricade or becoming critically wounded with full class ability energy creates a Sunspot at your location.
traits.descriptionZh: 装备烈日超能时，施放屏障或在职业技能能量已满的情况下受到重伤，会在你的位置创造一个太阳黑子。

traits.name: Consul's Pitch
traits.description: Hellion projectiles deal increased damage the further they travel eventually fracturing into scorching shrapnel.
traits.descriptionZh: 地狱火射弹飞行距离越远，造成的伤害越高，最终会分裂成灼烧碎片。

traits.name: Crystalline Transistor
traits.description:
Final blows from Kinetic weapons create an explosion in the element of your equipped Super that deals damage and applies a matching elemental effect:
• [Arc] Blinds targets.
• [Solar] Scorches targets.
• [Void] Weakens targets.
• [Stasis] Slows targets.
• [Strand] Severs targets.
Elemental final blows temporarily increase the explosion's size. Precision final blows always maximum the explosion's size.
traits.descriptionZh:
使用动能武器造成最后一击，会根据你已装备超能的元素产生爆炸，造成伤害并施加相应的元素效果：
•  致盲目标。
•  灼烧目标。
•  削弱目标。
•  减速目标。
•  割裂目标。
元素最后一击会提供临时性爆炸范围提升。精准最后一击直接达到最大爆炸范围。

traits.name: Battle-Hearth
traits.description: Kills and assists you make while standing in your Well of Radiance return Super energy.
traits.descriptionZh: 站在你的光焰之井中时完成击杀和助攻可返还超能能量。

traits.name: Winged Eclipse
traits.description:
Defeat targets to charge up cages of loyal moths that fly toward nearby targets or allies.
 
[Grenade]  : Throw the cage of loyal moths, which are released on impact. Upon reaching targets, moths detonate in a blinding explosion; upon reaching allies, moths provide a Void overshield.
traits.descriptionZh:
击败目标为一笼忠诚飞蛾充能，飞蛾会飞向附近的目标或盟友。
 
[手雷]  ：投掷这笼忠诚飞蛾，命中时释放飞蛾。飞蛾接触目标后将引发致盲爆炸；接触盟友后将为其提供虚空覆盖护盾。

traits.name: Friendly Competition
traits.description: You are representing this class and can acquire Platinum Cards and participate in the Ceremony weekend event.
traits.descriptionZh: 你目前代表这个职业，可以获得白金卡片及参与仪式周末活动。

traits.name: Puppeteer's Control
traits.description: Improves Drengr's Lash and spawns additional projectiles. These projectiles track targets more aggressively, travel farther, and suspend stronger. Gain Woven Mail when you suspend a target.
traits.descriptionZh: 提升勇士之鞭并生成额外射弹。射弹会更主动地跟踪目标，移动得更远，并且悬停效果更强。悬停目标时获得织造铠甲。

traits.name: Wish-Dragon's Talons
traits.description: Gain an additional Frenzied Blade charge. Frenzied Blade and Flechette Storm briefly increase their damage with each strike. Pulses from your Banner of War return melee energy based on the number of allies healed.
traits.descriptionZh: 获得一次额外的狂暴利刃充能。狂暴利刃和镖弹风暴会随每次打击短暂提升其伤害。战争旗帜发出的脉冲会基于治疗的盟友数量返还近战能量。

traits.name: Kismet
traits.description:
After landing a final blow while at full health, or when out of combat for an extended duration, your shields will slowly recharge into an overshield. 

When you have an overshield, your weapons gain increased accuracy, stability, handling, and damage against combatants, and final blows will grant a short period of increased mobility once the overshield is depleted.
traits.descriptionZh:
生命值全满时造成最后一击，或长时间脱离战斗后，你的护盾将缓慢充能形成覆盖护盾。

当你拥有覆盖护盾时，提升武器对战斗人员的精度、稳定性、操控性及伤害，覆盖护盾耗尽后，最后一击会在短时间内提供敏捷加成。

traits.name: Praxic Lift
traits.description:
You gain an air move jetpack. Weapon and Arc powered melee final blows build up Jetpack Fuel.

While airborne, [Air Dodge] : Charge your jetpack.

On release, activate your jetpack with a forceful blast of exhausting Arc energy then fly forward a short distance based on the amount charged. Collide with a combatant to unleash a blinding blast of energy and gain a temporary bonus to your melee stat.
traits.descriptionZh:
你获得空中移动喷气背包。武器和电弧充能近战最后一击可积累喷气背包燃料。

在空中时，[空中闪身] ：为喷气背包充能。

松开时，以强劲的排放电弧能量爆发启动喷气背包，然后根据充能量向前飞行一小段距离。与战斗人员碰撞会释放致盲能量爆破，并暂时提升你的近战属性。

Armor configured for Guardians that will hit you with every trick in the book.

Primary Stat: Class
Secondary Stat: Melee
archetypes.descriptionZh:
专为爱玩各种花招的守护者配置的护甲。

主要属性：职业
次要属性：近战
